title: How ThePrimeagen broke bad habits: choose in the moment, not by feeling
summary: ThePrimeagen explains how he overcame addictions and manages ADHD by acting on what he thinks is right instead of what he feels, and by quitting in the moment rather than at a future checkpoint. He also shares how a LinkedIn skill and a social-heavy interview landed him at Netflix, and which paths are easiest for getting hired.

principles.text: ADHD plus maturity is a superpower; ADHD plus excuses is a nightmare. You fight it every day.
principles.quote: ADHD plus maturity as a superpower ADHD plus excuses is a nightmare right like you got one or the other you have to fight it every single day

principles.text: Stop letting feelings dictate your actions; act on what you think is the right thing to do.
principles.quote: I started realizing I can control much much more of how I react not based on how I feel but what I think is the right thing to do

principles.text: Quit in the moment with a firm no, not at the end of the pack or tomorrow.
principles.quote: you don't stop at the end of a pack of cigarettes you stop in the moment it's always in the moment it's always a no at that moment

principles.text: Sustained daily effort eventually changes you; it is hard at first and then something clicks.
principles.quote: you do something long enough there just comes a point where the fruit of that trying changes you

principles.text: Don't aim for perfect discipline; accept you can't win everywhere and stop habits before they become a problem.
principles.quote: I would not call myself a fully disciplined person

principles.text: For getting hired, JavaScript UI (or Java) is the most accessible path because the job market is huge.
principles.quote: the easiest and most straightforward path of all time is Javascript UI that is the huge area
